svg.text: Fresh cluster a point, 70 s of load (Queen's 1k and 50k: 90 s), 100 messages of 256 B a request, nine load processes on three loaders; Pulsar's 50k
and 100k on six loaders (on three, the loaders ran out of CPU). Queen at 10M: idle partitions unloaded after 30 s (QUEEN_CONSUME_IDLE_UNLOAD_S=30),
the prefill drained before the load.
Before the answer: Queen and Pulsar wait for two fsyncs (Pulsar E3/Qw3/Qa2, journal sync on); Redpanda for a raft majority's fsync; Kafka (acks=all,
RF 3) writes to the page cache, no fsync.
Kafka: XFS, 24 request / 12 network / 12 replica-fetcher threads, writeback from 1 GB. Pulsar: memory sized for the 88 GB nodes, two journal dirs.
Redpanda: production tuners and rpk iotune.
Redpanda's CPU is its shards' busy time (the OS shows 66-71 cores: Seastar polls). Pulsar's 100k ran without the one-message warm-up (over 25 min at
100k). Redpanda's 100k not run after its 50k failed.
Queen 2.4.0-beta.1 runs of 10-15 (1k and 50k on 10-16); Kafka 4.3.1 of 10-14 (1k on 10-16); Pulsar 4.2.4 and Redpanda 26.2.3 of 10-16. The 10-16
